3706|10137e12.name: Tai'jin
3706|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

3707|10137e12.name: Ken'jai
3707|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

3085-accept.name: Gornek
3085-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the $c trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.
3085-accept.title: Hallowed Tablet

3085-complete.name: Ken'jai
3085-complete.text:
As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings...  dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... but only if da spirits agree.

Go now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.
3085-complete.title: Hallowed Tablet

3085-progress.name: Ken'jai
3085-progress.text: So ya made it... good good! Da spirits tol' me you be comin' to see Ken'jai soon enough. Let me be one o' da first to welcome ya to da Valley of Trials. Dis place not be your home fer long, but while it is, why dontcha make da best o' it.
3085-progress.title: Hallowed Tablet

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

5648-accept.name: Tai'jin
5648-accept.text:
You be ready for your first test, $N. South of Razor Hill, just outta town, one of our grunts be hurt fightin' off some o' Proudmoore's old troops. She not doin' too well, an' she benefit much if one of our kind could help her. Find her--her name be Kor'ja--heal her wounds, an' give her the blessin' of our ancestors.

You do this, an' me thinks that be sufficient proof that you ready to move on in our ways.
5648-accept.title: Garments of Spirituality

5648-complete.name: Tai'jin
5648-complete.text:
Good, then Kor'ja lives and goes off to defend our town from those malicious humans. I often wish to remember days of battle; where power was shown in combat and it was the wise who often destroyed those who relied on just their strength.

You done good by me, $N. You take this robe now. Maybe it help, maybe you not care, but you earned it and I'm proud to call you sister.
5648-complete.title: Garments of Spirituality

5649-accept.name: Ken'jai
5649-accept.text:
Aye, mon. Our kind have joined the Horde because they be good for us. They loyal, and they teach us much 'bout tings like honor. But our old ways die hard. The orcs may not approve of all our traditions, but that not mean we can't continue to practice some them in secret.

You know this, an' that's why I send you to Tai'jin in Razor Hill. She teach you more 'bout our history. She teach you the ways of our tribe. Go to her when you be ready.
5649-accept.title: In Favor of Spirituality

5649-complete.name: Tai'jin
5649-complete.text:
Ahh... so you finally come to Tai'jin. This be good.

You already know that we are not da same tribe that once joined with the Horde. We be much stronger now. We stronger 'cause we adapt--the Horde teach us that much. We no longer defeat our enemies and gain strength from them; now we gain strength, and then defeat our enemies.

The difference be subtle, but you will learn. You will see. The tribe count on you to learn such things.
5649-complete.title: In Favor of Spirituality

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96652-complete.name: Brakk
96652-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96652-complete.title: The Adventurer

96655-accept.name: Brakk
96655-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96655-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97279-progress.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279-progress.title: Wayward Weapons

97905-accept.name: Brakk
97905-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
